scope: E2E v7 post-task_done history marker observer, controller, launcher and media binding
findings: Successful execution terminal no longer closes the WS before native history publication; only matching prompt with explicit node:null after success qualifies for successful marker completion.
Error/interrupted end immediately. Existing disconnect invalidation, receive budgets, cancellation stop/join and process cleanup remain unchanged.
Controller keeps one-shot done consumption and original timeout fallback, so a permanently set event cannot create a tight polling loop.
Success and history-marker receipt timestamps are separate. Successful authoritative history can end observer waiting without inventing a missing marker; unavailable intervals remain null.

The event indicates ordering after native in-memory history publication; it does not prove durable persistence, complete GC or GPU-only timing. Signed reception-to-artifact intervals are observations, not performance claims.
Launcher v7 source filename/hash/freeze and unique output prefix match; media v7 source identity still validates both actual case-isolated outputs and four completed prompts/three releases.
Frozen resource thresholds, model graphs, async streams, headroom, no-pin, warm admission and owned cleanup retain prior semantics.
Original v6 and observer remain preserved. The offline static checker AsyncFunctionDef oversight is retained separately; candidate did not change for that checker repair.
